strategy.name: Release Spike Surfer
strategy.rule: When the 24h move (last trade vs the last trade a day ago) is >= 20c and 24h volume >= 1,000 on a market >= 24h old, buy the direction of the move with a +2c limit; sell at the first bid above entry, else hold to settlement.
strategy.why: Chases information releases on the official tape. Wins when the print is real (NFL final drive); loses when the spike is a trap.
